Reliance is placed on Section 166(3) of the MV Act which reads as follows:
"166. Application for compensation. ...

(3) No application for compensation shall be entertained unless it is made within six months of the occurrence of the accident."
7.
Learned Counsel for the Petitioner submits that despite the non- obstante clause as appearing in the statute and no provision for condonation of delay, the learned Tribunal has condoned the delay.
8. Issue Notice.
On steps being taken, let Notice be issued to the Respondents via all modes.
Dasti in addition.
An affidavit of service be filed within a week.

9. In the meantime, although the subject matter is also under consideration in a batch of cases before the Supreme Court in W.P.(C) 166/2024 captioned Bhagirathi Dash v.
